subject: Problem loading deducer on Mac 10.7.2 / Macbook air

messages.author: 07f45feec411e5ac
messages.subject: Problem loading deducer on Mac 10.7.2 / Macbook air
parts:
Hello everyone,

I have been using JGR/Deducer with much success on my old 32 bit Mac
running on 10.6.x
However I have not been able to load Deducer since I moved to my new
computer running Lion.

I installed all packages from CRAN. Version of deducer is 0.4-4,
version of R is 2.14.

Error message I get:

Error in assign(".jgr.works", TRUE,
as.environment(match("package:JGR", :
cannot change value of locked binding for '.jgr.works'
Failed with error: 'package 'Deducer' could not be loaded'

The data viewer and the menu items work. The dialog boxes work. I can
load data but when I click "run" on the dialog box, further error
shows up.

I am really desperate to get this to work as I have a deadline to meet
and I cannot run Deducer :( and I am too stupid to use R on the
terminal.

Please help me!

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Problem loading deducer on Mac 10.7.2 / Macbook air
parts:
Hi Henry,

0.4-4 is incompatible with R 2.14. A new version has been released to
CRAN, but the mac binaries have not yet been built. In the mean time
you should be able to install it by entering the following:

update.packages()
Sys.setenv(NOAWT=1)
install.packages("Deducer",type="source")

Ian

and feel. click save all. Then restart JGR/Deducer. Let me know if
that solves your issue. I don't have a lion system to test with...

messages.author: 056a0f54645c6009
messages.subject: Problem running a package under Deducer
parts:
I am working on use of reshape2 and found a great GUI for learning how
best to use plyr and reshape2.
package reshapeGIU

But it will not run under JGR-Deducer but will only using the main R2.14
console.

In Deducer It launches then hangs? I.E. Not Responding...

Conflict or sucking up too many shared resources to run?

Bruce

--
